PAPERFLOW_INGEST_TOKEN — a write-tier Auth and Tokens secret; without it, the mutation is rejected. The token-keyed path is how external tooling (like paperflow) pushes specs and plans into Barkpark as first-class Documents, served by the Phoenix API.

The same PortableDoc blocks render in the terminal: pdrender draws them inside the Go TUI's paper viewer, so a Paper reads the same on the web and in the shell. This makes Bulldocs a clean bridge between the Web Demo reader and the bp CLI / TUI world.
A Paper's inline Reference Fields feed the Content Graph like any other document, so Papers show up in the Graph View alongside schemas and datasets.
